question: What happens when awareness pervades all things through the desire to know them?
premises: A mere desire to see can become a mode of pervasion.
When one abides pervading all things, nothing further needs to be explained.
This teaching is stated in the Spanda scripture.
inference: Direct pervading awareness makes elaborate explanation unnecessary.
plain_english: When, by the mere desire to see, one abides pervading all things, what more needs to be said? So it is taught in the Spanda scripture.
